title: The Umbrella and the Knot
subtitle: It may not be important to remember an era, but it is important to remember the people.

items.text: The Umbrella and the Knot

We are prisoners within these cavern walls,
Our gazes held captive by the shadows' thrall.
Until our hands clasped and our chains rattled,
We united to break free from our shackles. 
The sightless joined forces with the soundless, 
And the voiceless uplifted the helpless, 
Together, we assembled a sliver of truth, 
A piece of the world hidden since youth.
Hallway, Foundation

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Have you got something for me, Mesmer?
Mesmer Jr. looks worn and tired, but her demeanor is still somewhat friendly.
Dark circles are clearly visible under Mesmer Jr.'s eyes, just like every Laplace member encountered today.

items.speaker: Mesmer Jr.
items.text: Yes. They asked me to give this to you.

items.speaker: Mesmer Jr.
items.text: The culmination of our research, the crystallization of man and all its wisdom—The protective gear against the "Storm."

items.speaker: Mesmer Jr.
items.text: An umbrella, something you personally don't really need.
She takes a sarcastic jab as she opens the white satin umbrella.

items.speaker: Mesmer Jr.
items.text: It's called the Equilibrium Umbrella. This is the first model, consisting of a converter, a harmonizer, and a ritual core.

items.speaker: Mesmer Jr.
items.text: The converter generates a balancing field that can cast rituals in the "Storm," taking account of the wielder's capabilities.

items.speaker: Mesmer Jr.
items.text: The harmonizer's markings are inspired by the scroll of Apeiron. Madam Lucy tested it against 162 known side effects and found it to be highly effective.

items.speaker: Mesmer Jr.
items.text: The original scroll has been returned to the island. This is only a simplified and duplicated rendition.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: The 162 curses aren't all of them, right?

items.speaker: Mesmer Jr.
items.text: Correct. There may be other unknown side effects, so the umbrella is only a prototype in the testing phase.

items.speaker: Mesmer Jr.
items.text: And, the ritual core. At first, it was called the "37-Lucy Knot" in honor of the two main contributors.

items.speaker: Mesmer Jr.
items.text: However, both of them turned it down.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Yes. I still remember what 37 said at the time.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: She would rather name it after the mathematical properties of the knot, even if it's too much of a mouthful.

items.speaker: Thirty-seven
items.text: No, no! 37 is not a name, and the Truth should not be dressed up with anyone's name!

items.speaker: Thirty-seven
items.text: I only found it. I didn't invent it. I don't need something named after me to prove my sense of existence.

items.speaker: Thirty-seven
items.text: Hmm, but I'm not on the island anymore. I can understand that the imaginary numbers need to honor the discovery.

items.speaker: Thirty-seven
items.text: You may use another contributor's name for it. I'm willing to accept that.

items.speaker: Mesmer Jr.
items.text: Madam Lucy showed no interest in the naming rights, so it was transferred to the third major contributor, Adler Hofmann.

items.speaker: Mesmer Jr.
items.text: Sadly, Researcher Adler also rejected the offer, at first. We nearly ended up using the date of that day as the name.

items.speaker: Mesmer Jr.
items.text: But he changed his mind after confirming he could use his family name instead.

items.speaker: Marcus
items.text: The Hofmann Knot?

items.speaker: Marcus
items.text: You named it after Madam Hofmann?

items.speaker: Foundation Staff II
items.text: Yes. Researcher Adler Hofmann wanted to make sure that Greta Hofmann would never be forgotten for her selfless sacrifice.

items.speaker: Foundation Staff II
items.text: Level Four Investigator Marcus, please accept this umbrella. It is rightfully yours.
She receives an Equilibrium Umbrella. Its pearly sheen creates an illusion of pure whiteness in front of her.

items.speaker: Foundation Staff II
items.text: Given the incredible contributions you have made, you are welcome to apply for a well-deserved and extended vacation.

items.speaker: Marcus
items.text: No. I will request for permission to go out.

items.speaker: Marcus
items.text: My era has gone. But with this umbrella in hand, I will venture into the new world and marvel at what's to come.
Marcus looks up at the sky.

items.speaker: Marcus
items.text: Will the Sachertorte taste the same?
With the umbrella in her arms, she bows to the Foundation staff member.
Then she turns and walks toward the light.

items.speaker: Mesmer Jr.
items.text: And lastly, the asymmetrical nuclide R in the handle of the umbrella is supposed to protect against the Storm Syndrome, but this still needs to be confirmed through testing.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: It's okay.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: This is the one thing we need the most.

items.speaker: Mesmer Jr.
items.text: If you have no further questions about its usage, I'm heading back to the rehab center.

items.speaker: Mesmer Jr.
items.text: The afflicted researchers there are in dire need of my magnet therapy.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Don't you think one is not enough for my needs?

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: I think five, no, 15 might be more helpful.
An unexpected question. Mesmer Jr. stops with a surprised look on her face.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: My suitcase can't protect humans from the "Storm." They'll need the umbrella to survive.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: In the future missions, I may encounter lots of—
Mesmer Jr. interrupts.

items.speaker: Mesmer Jr.
items.text: Just a reminder, Timekeeper: this is only a prototype.

items.speaker: Mesmer Jr.
items.text: The application forms for the umbrella are available in the Foundation lobby. Feel free to apply for as many as you need.
She turns and leaves, not staying for another second.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Thank you, Mesmer.
The amount of sunlight is just right.
The umbrella pops open, rotating with a touch of grace.
Against the white fabric, the golden knot gleams with brilliance.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: 37 was right.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: It is a beautiful shape indeed.
The Foundation Square has been restored to its former glory.
A recognizable figure stands there, having waited for a long time.

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: Hey Vertin! Did you get it done?

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Yes, it went smoothly. I was expecting something more complicated. So to get the umbrella, you only need to fill out forms.

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: Huh? That's not what I was talking about!

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: I'm talking about the brave and glorious sacrifice of my APPLe II! Don't you think the Foundation should compensate me with a shiny new ship?

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Oh.

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: "Oh"? What do you mean "Oh"?

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: Are you saying you totally forgot about it!?
Regulus closes in, offended, putting her hands on both her shoulders.

items.speaker: Lilya
items.text: Easy, Regulus. Those people are likely buried in paperwork right now. Just be patient and wait.
She twirls a golden medal between her fingers.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Lilya. How was your commendation ceremony?

items.speaker: Lilya
items.text: Heh. They rewarded me for escorting the important item during the "Storm."

items.speaker: Lilya
items.text: How is delivering a scroll worthy of a reward? I'll say someone should be grateful I didn't crash into the committee building.
She tosses the medal to Regulus.

items.speaker: Lilya
items.text: Take it. Might be useful for your alchemy.

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: Oh! Let me see.
Regulus brings the medal to her mouth and takes a small bite.

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: Thanks mate! It's made of pure gold!

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: On behalf of the pirate community, I thank you for your remarkable contribution to alchemy!

items.speaker: Druvis III
items.text: I have one, too.
Druvis III walks over and places another medal in Regulus's hand.
Like Lilya, she was rewarded for helping to deliver the scroll.

items.speaker: Druvis III
items.text: Please forgive my lack of contribution, Timekeeper.
She missed the island trip because of the forest they planted in the Foundation Square.
Fortunately, the square has been restored to its original condition.

items.speaker: Druvis III
items.text: It seems the awakened woods have embraced tranquility once more. Perhaps a sign of good things to come.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: I'm glad to see you back on your feet, Ms. Druvis.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: In fact, there's a place I'd like to introduce you to, a flourishing island that survived both war and the "Storm." I think a talented druid like you would be of great help to them.

items.speaker: Druvis III
items.text: Sounds like a place to look forward to.
The reunion is cut short by the pirate's cheering.

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: Nice job, Druvis! It's not as big as Lilya's, but it is made of a rare kind of metal!

items.speaker: APPLe
items.text: This is a good start, Captain. This APPLe thinks we only need 300 more medals to afford a new ship.

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: You read my mind, Mr. Chief Mate! When will Zeno's ceremony be held?

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: This Captain is not a fan of these ceremonies, so, um, could they just mail me my medal?
The rockin' pirate coughs awkwardly, her eyes darting away behind the cover of her shades.

items.speaker: Sotheby
items.text: Hmm? Did I miss something?

items.speaker: Sotheby
items.text: Are we holding a medal-exchanging party?

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: Sotheby!
Regulus rejoices at the sight of the little lady, tears welling up in her eyes.
She stretches out a hand, and Sotheby immediately gets the message.

items.speaker: Sotheby
items.text: But I don't have a medal. All I have is this big, round, golden ...
A handful of weighty jewelry is placed in Regulus's hands.

items.speaker: APPLe
items.text: Captain, I think we can buy a new ship with this.
Regulus wraps her in a ginormous bear hug, moved to tears.
Praise Sotheby—the most charitable woman in history, the revitalizer of the pirate community, the prime sponsor of the ingenious alchemist, and the bank vault on legs.

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: Regulus, Regulus!
Sonetto runs over panting, waving a stack of stamped papers in her hand.

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: The Timekeeper asked me to request a new ship for you, and we have the approval!

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: The Foundation will rebuild APPLe II and pay for its maintenance—hmm?

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Funny you say that, Sonetto.
The trees sway in the breeze and the sunlight streams through the leaves.
It is a fine weather to set sail again.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Now we have two new ships.
TO BE CONTINUED…
